# Wrapping a DOM element in SNGL is what maps the names. The standard library
# calls the event `@scrollEnd`; the DOM calls it `scrollend`; the override that
# wraps the element maps one to the other. The element's wildcard event stays
# lowercase, because that is the set of DOM event types -- accepting the SNGL
# spelling there would emit a listener for an event nothing fires.

sngl generate --lang none --platform html --out out app.sngl
grep 'addEventListener\("scrollend"' out/index.html
grep 'addEventListener\("click"' out/index.html

# The SNGL spelling must not reach the DOM: it is not an event type.
! grep 'addEventListener\("scrollEnd"' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var n = 0
    scroll(@scrollEnd { n = n + 1 }) {
        text(value=string(n))
    }
    button(text="hit", @click { n = n + 1 })
}
